Features:
The straight carbon shaft eliminates unnecessary functions and shapes, retaining only the bare minimum grip necessary. The aluminum frame features an opening that makes it easy to follow the fish in any situation and scoop it up easily. The net minimizes interference with hooks, significantly increasing the efficiency of the landing process.
The net mesh is finer than typically used, minimizing damage to the fish body. Furthermore, by exchanging the handle for the separately sold Landing Shaft 600, usability is improved in fishing spots where the water surface is close to the footing.
Net section inner diameter (maximum part): width 46cmxheight 45cm. Shaft diameter: 19mm. Depth: approximately 25cm

B-TRUE Rubber Landing Net

An aluminium-framed net with a smoke rubber mesh that keeps hooks from tangling and is kinder to the fish than knotted netting. The frame measures 34 x 42cm with a 27cm bag.

A one-action flip mechanism opens it in a single motion. The thread on the collar is a common size, so it fits the B-TRUE Slide Shaft 400 as well as most other landing poles. A hook-and-loop mesh case is included.

Features:
A landing net designed to bring fish in safely and reliably.
The 72 has a slide-extending shaft, ideal for boat and area fishing. The 480 extends up to 4.8 m, perfect for bank fishing where footing is unstable—high platforms or steep slopes—making landing difficult.
Land fish safely without worrying about hooks or thin lines such as spinning setups. The fish-friendly rubber net (polyester rubber-coated on the 480) protects your catch.

B-TRUE Slide Shaft 400

A 4m telescopic shaft that doubles as a lure retriever. Ten sections collapse to 51cm, so it stows in a boat locker or a rod case and comes out when a fish or a snagged lure is further away than an arm's reach.

The 7.5cm recovery top unscrews, which lets you swap in the B-TRUE Rubber Landing Net (sold separately) and use the same shaft as a landing pole.
